definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese square cloth used to wrap and carry items.

examples.japanese: {風呂敷|ふろしき}で{包|つつ}む。
{風呂敷|ふろしき}を{広|ひろ}げる。
{風呂敷|ふろしき}はエコバッグ{代|が}わりになる。
examples.english: A furoshiki can be used as an eco-bag.

examples.japanese: おばあちゃんは{風呂敷|ふろしき}で{何|なん}でも{上手|じょうず}に{包|つつ}む。
examples.english: Grandma wraps everything skillfully with a furoshiki.

examples.japanese: {風呂敷|ふろしき}は{色々|いろいろ}な{形|かたち}のものを{包|つつ}めるので{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: Furoshiki are convenient because they can wrap things of various shapes.

notes:
{風呂敷|ふろしき} is a traditional square cloth used for wrapping and carrying objects.

ETYMOLOGY:
The name literally means "bath spread" - originally used to wrap clothes when visiting public baths ({銭湯|せんとう}).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {風呂敷|ふろしき}で{包|つつ}む: to wrap in a furoshiki
- {風呂敷|ふろしき}{包|づつ}み: furoshiki bundle

IDIOMS:
- {風呂敷|ふろしき}を{広|ひろ}げる: to exaggerate, make grand claims
- {大|おお}{風呂敷|ぶろしき}を{広|ひろ}げる: to make big boasts

CULTURAL NOTE:
Recently revived as an eco-friendly alternative to plastic bags. Available in various sizes and patterns.
